summary: FD_TC_212_3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim Opened � Not in CS � EU Country (France) � Manual Handoff
title: 3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim Opened � Not in CS � EU Country (France) � Manual Handoff
description:
Validates that when a claims company submits on behalf of a passenger, the claim was opened but not found in CS, and the country of origin is an EU-eligible country (France), the system collects required information and sends the case for manual handling.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Claims Company. Passenger has opened a claim. Case number not in CS. Country of origin: France.
